reviews.body: Thanks for the PR. I think there is still some work left. This is a general problem, so we don't want to take a special casing solution.

review_comments.body:
The problem isn't unique to resources. This should be part of a general name rewrite mechanism that applies to all top level declarations.

We probably want to fold this into `nameRewrites`, and then make sure that the converter correctly tracks this across traversals.
Let's use the `hcltest` framework for this. I'm leery of asserting code is correct without a computer running it.
We already have `uniqueName`. Let's not duplicate it.

comments.body:
Merged master into the branch. The conflict in `newProjectTransformer` was trivial (stale `functionSchemas` init vs. the renamed `providerFunctions` map). Master also added `TestConvertSameAddressInModulesOfDifferentPackages`, which failed against the original global rewrite: modules are converted to separate PCL files, so two same-named resources in different module directories do not collide. Resource-name rewrites are now keyed and claimed per module directory.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

Thanks for the review. Reworked as asked, in follow-up commits on the same branch:

- Collision handling is no longer resource-only. `nameRewrites` is now keyed by module directory, reference root (`var`, `module`, or the resource type) and logical name, and it covers resources, variables and modules. The separate `resourceRewrites` map and `computeResourceRewrites` are gone.
- Collisions and invalid names both go through the existing `uniqueName`, instead of a second copy of that loop. Valid names are claimed first, so a rewritten name never takes one a later declaration is entitled to.
- References follow the rewrite for their own kind: `var.x` and `module.x` look up their own entry, and `local.x` is no longer rewritten by a variable of the same name.
- Tests: `TestEjectSameNameAcrossKinds` in `converter_test.go` (variable, resource and module sharing `x`; fails on the previous commit, passes now), plus an hcltest case, `l2_same_name_declarations`, that runs a variable and a resource with the same name through `pulumi up` and the PCL round trip.

The converter package tests and the full hcltest suite pass, including the new hcltest case (`TestL2SameNameDeclarations`, including the PCL and HCL round-trips). In the generated PCL the variable keeps `thing` and the resource becomes `thing_`, with the references pointing at the right one.

This change was prepared with the help of an AI assistant (Claude Code), and the author is responsible for the change.
Hi @pcbeingused333. After another look at the problem space, I decided I wanted a more holistic change on this: https://github.com/pulumi/pulumi-hcl/pull/822. Thanks for getting the ball rolling.
